items.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a call from President Trump on Monday while onstage at the All-In Podcast’s All-In Summit. It’s not the first time Huang has taken a call from the president during work, but this time he put Trump on speakerphone before a big crowd.During the call, the president launched into his take on recent fears about AI development, which he called a “hoax,” and told the crowd that “the robots will not be taking over.”It’s already a frothy week for AI news. The call with the president followed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s long essay published this weekend titled “We Must Pace the Frontier” where he argued for slowing down AI development and coordination between governments. The essay sparked many responses from AI executives, who generally agreed. But Trump pushed back in Truth Social posts on Monday and repurposed some of what he said in those posts at the event. Heard onstage, Trump also commented on data centers, claiming there would be communities that would be “dying” without data centers but were now “really wealthy” (though without providing specifics).Huang did not push back, saying instead that “We’re going to make sure that everybody wins in the AI race in America. Every industry, every company, every state, every people.” Huang also appealed to Trump by telling him he was speaking to “thousands” of people.You can hear all of Trump’s comments in recordings of the appearance on X:

items.titleZh: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
items.descriptionZh:
在All-In播客的All-In峰会上，Nvidia CEO黄仁勋在台上时接到了特朗普总统的电话。这并非黄仁勋第一次在工作中接听总统来电，但这次他将特朗普设为免提模式，让在场众多观众都能听到对话。通话中，特朗普总统阐述了他对近期AI发展担忧的看法，称其为“骗局”，并向观众表示“机器人不会接管世界”。

本周AI新闻本就热闹非凡。这通总统来电之前，Anthropic CEO达里奥·阿莫代伊于本周末发表了一篇题为《我们必须把握前沿节奏》的长文，主张放缓AI发展速度并呼吁各国政府之间进行协调。该文引发了众多AI高管的回应，他们普遍表示认同。但特朗普周一在Truth Social上发文反驳，并在活动中部分重复了这些帖子的内容。在台上，特朗普还谈到了数据中心，声称有些社区如果没有数据中心就会“消亡”，但现在却“非常富有”（不过未提供具体细节）。

黄仁勋并未反驳，而是表示：“我们将确保在美国的AI竞赛中每个人都是赢家。每个行业、每家公司、每个州、每个人。”黄仁勋还迎合特朗普，告诉他自己正在对“数千”人讲话。

items.title: Nvidia's RTX 5090 vanishes from online retail in the US — third-party sellers now demand as much as $9,500 for Nvidia's fastest GPU
items.description: The RTX 5090 is out of stock from first-party sellers online in the U.S., with third-party sellers now asking for as much as $9,500 for the GPU.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's fastest gaming graphics card, the RTX 5090, has been on a tear of price increases over the past several weeks. However, over the past week, the available inventory has dwindled. Now, you can only find the RTX 5090 from third-party sellers at online retailers like Newegg and Amazon, commanding anywhere from $6,500 to $9,500 (or even higher) for Team Green's best GPU.Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs (Image credit: Noctua)Desktop GPU RoadmapNvidia's Enterprise GPU RoadmapTesting DirectStorage with GPU decompressionThe GeForce RTX 30-series upgrade matrix — does your Ampere GPU need an upgrade in 2026?Rubin in-depthThe Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PCAt Newegg, the cheapest RTX 5090 is the MSI Ventus 3X that's available from Slava Computers (a relatively new seller with 239 ratings and a 2.8 out of 5 rating at the time of writing) for $6,449. On Amazon, you can get the Asus TUF Gaming OC for $6,395 from Joes Tech Shop, a seller with an 81% positive rating. However, among the most recent reviews are a string of one-star reviews about orders never being fulfilled. The cost goes much higher, as well. The first result for "RTX 5090" on Newegg, for example, surfaces the MSI Ventus 3X OC for $8,699.In June, the median price for an RTX 5090 was $4,299. At the beginning of September, we logged the lowest online price at $5,199 in our GPU price tracker. Now, in less than two weeks, the available stock has completely disappeared online, and the options available from third-party sellers have ballooned in price once again.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Naturally, we don't recommend buying from one of these third-party sellers. The RTX 5090 is selling at a vastly inflated price, but more importantly, we've seen no shortage of scams around high-ticket items like the RTX 5090. In January, 42 Amazon customers were duped into a scam involving a $999 RTX 5090, instead receiving a fanny pack in place of the GPU. Earlier this month, an online seller scammed two buyers with the RTX 5090, selling phantom graphics cards with the core and memory removed on the secondhand market for prices near MSRP.The one exception to RTX 5090 inventory is Micro Center, which still has cards available around the average selling price. At a local Micro Center we checked, the cheapest in-stock option was $4,299. Micro Center has exclusively sold graphics cards in-person for several years, insulating it from online buyouts like what appears to be going on right now. The RTX 5090 holds the GB202 GPU and 32GB of GDDR7 memory. For context, Nvidia's RTX Pro 5000 48GB comes with the same GPU with a third fewer shader units enabled, and lower memory bandwidth compared to the RTX 5090, and sells for between $7,000 and $9,000. In that context, the RTX 5090 starts to look attractive for building an AI server, even at $5,000 (or more) apiece.At the same time, the RTX 5090 remains the fastest gaming graphics card on the market according to the testing in our GPU benchmark hierarchy. items.titleZh: Nvidia's RTX 5090 vanishes from online retail in the US — third-party sellers now demand as much as $9,500 for Nvidia's fastest GPU
items.descriptionZh:
Nvidia 旗下最快的游戏显卡 GeForce RTX 5090 正遭遇严重缺货和价格失控。过去数周，RTX 5090 的价格持续上涨；过去一周，线上库存进一步枯竭。目前在 Newegg、Amazon 等在线零售商处，RTX 5090 基本只能通过第三方卖家购买，报价约在 6,500 至 9,500 美元甚至更高。

具体来看，Newegg 上最便宜的 RTX 5090 是 MSI Ventus 3X，由 Slava Computers 出售，价格为 6,449 美元；该卖家相对较新，当时仅有 239 条评价，评分 2.8/5。Amazon 上 Asus TUF Gaming OC 由 Joes Tech Shop 出售，价格 6,395 美元，卖家好评率为 81%，但近期评论中出现多起未发货的一星投诉。Newegg 搜索“RTX 5090”的首个结果则是 MSI Ventus 3X OC，价格高达 8,699 美元。作为对比，今年 6 月 RTX 5090 的中位价为 4,299 美元，9 月初 Tom's Hardware 价格追踪记录到的最低线上价格为 5,199 美元；不到两周后，线上库存完全消失，第三方卖家价格再次膨胀。

Tom's Hardware 明确不建议从这些第三方卖家购买。除了价格严重虚高，RTX 5090 这类高单价商品还频繁出现诈骗。今年 1 月，42 名 Amazon 顾客在一场 999 美元 RTX 5090 骗局中受骗，收到的不是显卡而是腰包；本月早些时候，还有线上卖家在二手市场以接近建议零售价的价格出售被拆掉核心和显存的“空壳显卡”，两名买家上当。唯一例外是 Micro Center，该零售商仍有接近平均售价的库存，当地门店检查到的最便宜现货为 4,299 美元。Micro Center 多年来只在线下销售显卡，因此避免了被线上扫货和抢购潮冲击。

RTX 5090 需求如此旺盛的核心原因仍是 AI。该卡搭载 GB202 GPU 和 32GB GDDR7 显存。相比之下，Nvidia RTX Pro 5000 48GB 使用相同 GPU，但启用的着色器单元比 RTX 5090 少约三分之一，显存带宽也更低，售价却在 7,000 至 9,000 美元之间。在这一背景下，即使 RTX 5090 单价达到 5,000 美元甚至更高，用于搭建 AI 服务器也显得有吸引力。

与此同时，根据 Tom's Hardware GPU 基准测试层级，RTX 5090 仍是市场上最快的游戏显卡。随着 Nvidia 推出 DLSS 5 神经渲染，RTX 5090 能充分利用这一 AI 渲染技术；不过 Tom's Hardware 的广泛测试也发现，较低端显卡同样能达到可玩性能。Tom's Hardware 已联系 Nvidia，询问其是否有稳定库存的计划，若获得回复将更新报道。

items.title: Gaming takes a backseat as Nvidia overhauls the RTX 5090 for maximum AI margins — RTX Pro 5500 delivers 2.6X VRAM at matching specs
items.description: Nvidia launches the RTX Pro 5500 Blackwell Workstation Edition graphics card for agentic and generative AI.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The GeForce RTX 5090 is undeniably one of the best graphics cards money can buy. Banking on the fact that many already use it for AI, Nvidia has bolstered it with even more memory and launched it as the new RTX 5500 Pro Blackwell Workstation Edition. It offers comparable specifications to the GeForce RTX 5090 but distinguishes itself with 84GB of GDDR7 memory, 2.6X more than the Blackwell gaming flagship.Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs (Image credit: Noctua)Desktop GPU RoadmapNvidia's Enterprise GPU RoadmapTesting DirectStorage with GPU decompressionThe GeForce RTX 30-series upgrade matrix — does your Ampere GPU need an upgrade in 2026?Rubin in-depthThe Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PCThe RTX Pro 5500 features the GB202 silicon, the powerhouse die that powers other high-end mainstream and professional Blackwell graphics cards, including the GeForce RTX 5090, RTX Pro 6000, and RTX Pro 5000. In fact, the RTX Pro 5500 uses the same die as the GeForce RTX 5090, which means 170 Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) are enabled out of a possible 192. As a result, the RTX Pro 5500 has 21,760 CUDA cores and offers performance comparable to the GeForce RTX 5090. The differentiator is the memory subsystem, where the RTX Pro 5500 excels.Nvidia equipped the RTX Pro 5500 with 84GB of GDDR7 memory. This is the second time Nvidia has launched a graphics card with 84GB of memory, with the first being the China-exclusive RTX Pro 6000D. The RTX Pro 5500's memory capacity lets the Blackwell graphics card sit comfortably between the RTX Pro 5000 and the upgraded RTX Pro 6000, with 72GB and 96GB of GDDR7 memory, respectively.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 Workstation Edition Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Graphics Card RTX Pro 6000 RTX Pro 6000D RTX Pro 5500 RTX 5090 RTX Pro 5000 Architecture GB202 GB202 GB202 GB202 GB202 Process Technology TSMC 4N TSMC 4N TSMC 4N TSMC 4N TSMC 4N Transistors (Billion) 92.2 92.2 92.2 92.2 92.2 Die size (mm^2) 750 750 750 750 750 SMs 188 156 170 170 110 CUDA Cores 24,064 19,968 21,760 21,760 14,080 Tensor Cores 752 624 680 680 440 Ray Tracing Cores 188 156 176 176 110 Boost Clock (MHz) 2,617 2,430 ? 2,407 2,617 VRAM Speed (Gbps) 28 25 25 28 28 VRAM (GB) 96 84 84 32 48 / 72 VRAM Bus Width 512 448 448 512 384 L2 Cache 128 128 96 96 96 Render Output Units 192 192 192 176 176 Texture Mapping Units 752 624 680 680 440 TFLOPS FP32 (Boost) 126.0 97.04 ? 104.8 73.69 Bandwidth (GB/s) 1,792 1,400 1,398 1,790 1,344 TBP (watts) 600 600 600 575 300 Nvidia achieved the 84GB memory capacity by outfitting the RTX Pro 5500 with 28 GDDR7 memory chips in a clamshell configuration. Each side of the PCB houses 14 24Gb (3GB) GDDR7 memory modules. They run at 25 Gb/s across a 448-bit memory interface, delivering up to 1,400 GB/s of bandwidth, which aligns with Nvidia’s official specification of 1,398 GB/s. In other words, the RTX Pro 5500 shares the same memory subsystem as the RTX Pro 6000D.Samsung, Micron, and SK hynix only produce standard 28 Gb/s memory packages. Therefore, Nvidia downclocks the RTX Pro 5500's GDDR7 chips for its own reasons, whether to meet thermal and power targets or avoid cannibalizing higher-tier SKUs. From a memory-bandwidth perspective, the RTX Pro 5500 is not particularly impressive. Its bandwidth is only 4% ahead of the RTX Pro 5000, and it lags 22% behind both the flagship RTX Pro 6000 and the GeForce RTX 5090, which fully leverage 28 Gb/s GDDR7 memory chips. You may like China-modified Nvidia RTX 5090 with massive 96GB of memory appears on Alibaba for less than $4,000 Nvidia's RTX 5090 vanishes from online retail in the US Nvidia's top-end RTX 5090 gaming GPU now costs at least $5,000 To sum it all up, if RTX Pro 6000D and GeForce RTX 5090 had a child, it would be the RTX Pro 5500. Nvidia's main motivation was to launch the RTX Pro 5500 to fill the large performance and pricing gap between the RTX Pro 6000 and RTX Pro 5000. Also, the chipmaker makes substantially more profit by putting recycled GB202 into an RTX Pro 5500 than into a GeForce RTX 5090. By giving the former more memory with similar core specifications as the latter, Nvidia seemingly hopes to win more customers over to the RTX Pro 5500.We reached out to both Nvidia and PNY for official pricing on the RTX Pro 5500, but neither company has responded. For reference, the flagship RTX Pro 6000 retails for $15,599, while an RTX Pro 5000 72GB starts at $9,209. items.titleZh: Gaming takes a backseat as Nvidia overhauls the RTX 5090 for maximum AI margins — RTX Pro 5500 delivers 2.6X VRAM at matching specs
items.descriptionZh:
Nvidia 近日推出 RTX Pro 5500 Blackwell 工作站版显卡，本质上是把 GeForce RTX 5090 的核心规格与更大显存结合，面向 AI 和专业工作站市场。RTX 5090 已被广泛用于 AI 任务，Nvidia 借此基础将其强化为专业产品，显存从 32GB 提升到 84GB GDDR7，达到游戏旗舰的 2.6 倍，填补 RTX Pro 6000 与 RTX Pro 5000 之间的性能与价格空档。

核心方面，RTX Pro 5500 采用 GB202 芯片，与 RTX 5090、RTX Pro 6000、RTX Pro 5000 同源。其 192 个流式多处理器（SM）中启用 170 个，提供 21,760 个 CUDA 核心、680 个 Tensor 核心、176 个光线追踪核心、96MB L2 缓存、192 个 ROP 和 680 个 TMU，总板功耗 600W。Boost 频率和 FP32 算力尚未公布，但核心规模与 RTX 5090 基本一致，计算性能预计接近。区别主要在显存子系统：RTX Pro 5500 配备 84GB GDDR7，通过 clamshell 夹层配置实现，PCB 两面各焊 14 颗 24Gb（3GB）GDDR7 芯片，共 28 颗，搭配 448-bit 位宽，显存速率 25 Gb/s，带宽约 1,398 GB/s。这与 RTX Pro 6000D 的显存子系统相同，也是 Nvidia 第二次推出 84GB 显存显卡，首次是中国特供的 RTX Pro 6000D。

对比来看，RTX Pro 6000 拥有 96GB GDDR7、512-bit 位宽、28 Gb/s、1,792 GB/s 带宽、188 SM、24,064 CUDA 核心、752 Tensor 核心，FP32 算力 126 TFLOPS，TBP 600W，售价 15,599 美元。RTX Pro 6000D 为 84GB、448-bit、25 Gb/s、1,400 GB/s 带宽、156 SM、19,968 CUDA 核心、624 Tensor 核心、97.04 TFLOPS，TBP 600W。RTX Pro 5000 提供 48GB 或 72GB、384-bit、28 Gb/s、1,344 GB/s 带宽、110 SM、14,080 CUDA 核心、440 Tensor 核心、73.69 TFLOPS，TBP 300W，72GB 版起价 9,209 美元。RTX 5090 则是 32GB、512-bit、28 Gb/s、1,790 GB/s 带宽、170 SM、21,760 CUDA 核心、680 Tensor 核心、104.8 TFLOPS，TBP 575W。

RTX Pro 5500 的显存带宽并不突出：仅比 RTX Pro 5000 高约 4%，却比 RTX Pro 6000 和 RTX 5090 低约 22%。原因是三星、美光、SK 海力士只生产标准 28 Gb/s GDDR7 封装，Nvidia 将其降频至 25 Gb/s，可能是为了满足散热与功耗目标，或避免蚕食更高阶 SKU。总体而言，RTX Pro 5500 像是 RTX Pro 6000D 与 RTX 5090 的结合体：核心规格接近 5090，显存容量看齐 6000D。Nvidia 的动机包括填补产品线空白、利用回收的 GB202 芯片获取比游戏卡更高的利润，并以大显存吸引 AI 客户。官方价格尚未公布，Nvidia 和 PNY 也未回应询问；参考 RTX Pro 6000 的 15,599 美元和 RTX Pro 5000 72GB 的 9,209 美元，RTX Pro 5500 预计定价在这两者之间。该卡适合需要超大显存进行大模型推理、AI 训练或专业可视化的工作站用户，但在显存带宽敏感型任务中并不占优。

items.title: Nvidia, Palantir, and others restrict advanced AI model usage over privacy concerns, report claims — 'paranoia' rising over customer intellectual property
items.description: Companies are concerned that their intellectual property may be used by Anthropic and OpenAI to help improve their AI models.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Anthropic and OpenAI are both facing uncomfortable questions from some large AI customers over concerns about how proprietary data may be used to train AI models. Some companies are so worried that they have begun demanding assurances about how their data is handled or going so far as to place limitations on which models their employees can use, and for which tasks, The Information reports. They fear that models may be trained on their intellectual property and information.The issue can be traced back to a June change by Anthropic. Following the change to its flagship Fable model's policies, Anthropic can now retain customer data. The company argues that it only does so to ensure that Fable isn't being misused. But some companies have raised concerns that it means sensitive business data will be caught up in the sweep.While both OpenAI and Anthropic point out that they don't train their models on the information given to them by companies with specific enterprise contracts by default, that doesn't tell the full story. Both companies do collect metadata from the same corporate customers, and while information on exactly what that metadata contains is hard to come by, OpenAI notes that it's only used “to better understand how our services are used." Anthropic also argues that any data it collects about how customers use its products is aggregated and anonymized. And that metadata isn't used to train models.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Regardless, there are still concerns over a perceived lack of clarity about what is collected. Telecoms outfit C Spire has agreements with both OpenAI and Anthropic that prevent either from using its data to train models, the report says.However, the contracts do allow both OpenAI and Anthropic to collect C Spire technical usage data. C Spire believes that includes information about what applications AI models are connected to as well as usage data. It also worries that the AI companies may collect information about what their models get up to between generating responses. You may like Palantir CEO Alex Karp claims AI companies are stealing customers' data while charging them for unproductive tokens OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic absent from Nvidia-led Open Secure AI Alliance Nvidia and 24 other companies sign open-weights letter as Washington weighs Chinese AI model ban For its part, OpenAI says that it does not use this "chain-of-thought" data to train its models. But C Spire still believes it needs a better understanding of what data is being collected, the report adds. It argues that neither AI company is being clear in its explanations.Taking the private approachOne solution to any privacy concerns could be to use air-gapped servers, something aerospace company Northrop Grumman has already chosen to do. The Information reports that the company runs open-source AI models on its own air-gapped servers rather than trusting the likes of OpenAI and Anthropic.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsAlternatively, Microsoft is already trying to take advantage of any data privacy concerns by tempting OpenAI and Anthropic customers to its own secure AI platforms. Microsoft's isolated cloud environments run AI models on private servers that don't send any data to external AI companies. But this approach is costly, and the report notes that at least one customer is still considering Microsoft's alternative approach.Pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk has taken a slightly different approach. While it continues to use Anthropic's Claude for some tasks, it has a ban on allowing any proprietary data to be used by the model.It's clear that a lack of trust has the potential to cost AI companies real money, and in one instance, it already has. The same report notes that a large U.S. utility company has already canceled its plans to test Anthropic's Fable. The utility company wanted to know if Fable could run its core power infrastructure but ultimately pulled the plug over Anthropic's refusal to agree to a nonrevocable zero data retention (ZDR) policy.Nvidia has also decided to use Fable for tasks that don't require it to gain access to sensitive data. The company points to the same lack of ZDR guarentees as the reason. Instead, Nvidia uses its own in-house AI solution for tasks that it deems too sensitive for Anthropic's model. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has famously remarked that its employees should use AI tokens worth half their annual salary every year.Toms Hardware reached out to Nvidia for comment but did not receive one by publication. items.titleZh: Nvidia, Palantir, and others restrict advanced AI model usage over privacy concerns, report claims — 'paranoia' rising over customer intellectual property
items.descriptionZh:
Anthropic与OpenAI正面临来自部分大型企业AI客户的尖锐质询：这些客户担心自己的专有数据可能被用于训练AI模型。The Information报道称，一些公司已开始要求AI厂商就数据处理方式作出保证，甚至限制员工可以使用哪些模型、用于哪些任务。它们担心自身知识产权和商业信息被模型学习。这一问题可追溯至Anthropic在6月对其旗舰Fable模型政策所作的调整。调整后，Anthropic可以保留客户数据。公司称保留数据仅是为了确保Fable不被滥用，但部分企业担心敏感业务数据会被纳入留存范围。OpenAI和Anthropic均表示，对于签署特定企业合同的客户，默认不会用其提供的信息训练模型。然而报道指出，这并未呈现全貌：两家公司仍会从这些企业客户处收集元数据。虽然元数据具体包含什么难以获知，但OpenAI称其仅用于“更好理解服务如何被使用”；Anthropic则称收集的客户使用数据经过聚合和匿名化，元数据不用于训练模型。尽管如此，企业客户仍认为数据收集范围缺乏明确性。

电信公司C Spire的案例具有代表性。它与OpenAI和Anthropic签有协议，阻止两家公司用其数据训练模型，但合同允许两家公司收集C Spire的“技术使用数据”。C Spire认为，这可能包括AI模型连接了哪些应用以及使用数据；它还担心AI公司会收集模型在生成回答“之间”的行为信息，即所谓的“思维链”数据。OpenAI表示不会用这种思维链数据训练模型，但C Spire仍认为需要更清楚地了解究竟收集了什么，并批评两家AI公司解释不够清晰。这里涉及的核心技术边界是：企业合同通常只承诺“不用提示和输出训练”，但使用日志、应用连接、中间推理步骤等是否属于训练或改进数据，往往模糊。对金融、电信、公用事业等敏感行业，这种模糊会直接触发合规和商业机密风险。

为规避风险，一些企业转向私有化方案。航空航天公司Northrop Grumman选择在自有的气隙服务器上运行开源AI模型，而不是信任OpenAI和Anthropic。所谓气隙，是服务器与外部网络物理隔离，数据不出本地，因而能最大限度防止专有信息流向外部AI厂商。微软则试图把这种担忧转化为商机，推出隔离云环境，在私有服务器上运行AI模型，不向外部AI公司发送任何数据。但该方案成本较高，报道称至少有一个客户仍在考虑是否采用。制药公司Novo Nordisk采取折中：继续用Anthropic的Claude处理部分任务，但禁止任何专有数据被模型使用。

信任缺失已经开始造成实际商业损失。报道称，一家美国大型公用事业公司原本计划测试Anthropic的Fable，以评估其能否运行核心电力基础设施，但最终取消，原因是Anthropic拒绝同意“不可撤销的零数据保留”（ZDR）政策。ZDR意味着服务商在请求处理后不存储任何客户数据，且承诺不可撤销；对于关键基础设施和国防等场景，这往往是采购前提。Nvidia也决定仅在不需要接触敏感数据的任务中使用Fable，原因同样是缺乏ZDR保证；对于过于敏感的任务，Nvidia改用自家内部AI方案。Nvidia CEO黄仁勋曾表示，员工每年应使用价值相当于其年薪一半的AI tokens。截至发稿，Nvidia未对Tom's Hardware的置评请求作出回应。

从对比看，报道没有给出模型性能、延迟、吞吐或成本等具体参数，核心是数据治理模式差异：OpenAI与Anthropic提供前沿模型能力，但默认企业合同只覆盖“不训练”，仍收集元数据和技术使用数据，且不轻易承诺不可撤销ZDR；Northrop Grumman式气隙部署最安全，但依赖开源模型和自有运维，可能无法直接获得最前沿闭源模型；微软隔离云在安全与便利间折中，但价格高；Novo Nordisk则通过禁止专有数据进入模型来限制风险。这些选择将影响企业AI落地：高敏感行业可能更多采用私有云、本地推理、开源模型和严格数据分区，从而推动本地AI基础设施和加速芯片需求；AI厂商则需在合同透明度、数据保留政策和ZDR上给出更强保证，否则可能失去大客户。整体而言，企业AI采购正从“模型能力优先”转向“能力与数据主权并重”，信任成为商业化的关键门槛。

items.title: Perplexity Portable Computer Is Now Available on Windows, Powered by NVIDIA RTX
items.description: As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device. items.content: As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device. Portable Computer is a local version of the agent Perplexity Computer that plans and carries out multistep tasks. Accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs, it uses local models to analyze data, bring together information across files and handle recurring work. Sensitive information stays on device, and locally completed work doesn’t consume Perplexity Computer credits. Users can also orchestrate work up to cloud models for more advanced research and reasoning. Today, Perplexity is adding Portable Computer in the Perplexity app for Windows on compatible NVIDIA GeForce RTX PCs and NVIDIA RTX PRO Workstations, bringing powerful agentic AI to more Windows PC users. The release builds on existing support for NVIDIA DGX Spark systems and RTX PCs running Linux. Local Agents Powered by NVIDIA RTX Perplexity brings local and cloud AI together in one app, letting users work with sensitive files on their PCs and take advantage of Computer’s built-in tools such as the built-in browser and proprietary SPACE sandbox. For tasks that call for more advanced reasoning, Portable Computer can also identify when a task needs cloud support, asking the user for permission before sending information off-device. The app simplifies setup with a local model, such as Qwen 3.8 27B, that is post-trained to work with Perplexity Computer and optimized for NVIDIA RTX GPUs. Users can put the agent to work without having to research models or configure the complex software stack typically required to run local AI. Connectors for Microsoft Outlook, OneDrive, Word, Google Drive, Gmail, Slack and GitHub extend that experience across the files and apps already part of users’ daily workflows. For example, the agent can help with: Engineering: Review open pull requests in a connected GitHub project, organize them by status and identify next steps. Computer can also flag outdated documentation and submit proposed updates for review. Finance: Point Computer at two years of brokerage summaries, consolidated 1099s and tax returns, and have it trace the recurring holdings creating the most avoidable fees and tax drag, with every figure cited to the exact file and page — all without a document ever reaching a chatbot. Startups: Ask Computer why activation went flat, and the agent analyzes the funnel export locally to find where new signups drop off between install and first completed task, then posts the top insights straight to the team’s Slack channel. Try Portable Computer on Windows PCs Today Portable Computer is available for NVIDIA GeForce RTX and RTX PRO GPUs with 24GB or more of VRAM. NVIDIA DGX Station support is expected to come soon. Try Perplexity Portable Computer today. #ICYMI: The Latest Updates From NVIDIA Local AI 🧠Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 Flash provides impressive performance and visual intelligence at low cost, optimized for DGX Station and dual DGX Spark systems. 🐋DeepSeek-v4.1 Flash significantly reduces key-value cache memory demands and operating costs for complex AI agent workloads, delivering remarkable intelligence per dollar. ⚡Qwen has released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model, and an early preview of Qwen4, which can run locally on a single DGX Spark with NVFP4 and punches well above its weight. 👾GLM 5.3 is Z.ai’s 744-billion-parameter flagship model, tuned for agent sessions that run for hours on DGX Station and a cluster of four DGX Spark systems. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. See notice regarding software product information.

items.titleZh: Perplexity Portable Computer Is Now Available on Windows, Powered by NVIDIA RTX
items.descriptionZh:
随着本地模型能力增强，AI agent 已能在 PC 上直接承担更多工作，同时把敏感信息留在设备端。Perplexity 宣布推出 Portable Computer——Perplexity Computer 的本地版本，可在 PC 上规划和执行多步任务。它由 NVIDIA GPU 加速，使用本地模型分析数据、汇总跨文件信息并处理重复性工作。敏感信息保留在设备上，本地完成的任务也不消耗 Perplexity Computer 积分。用户还可以把工作编排到云模型，以进行更高级的研究和推理。此前该能力已支持 NVIDIA DGX Spark 系统和运行 Linux 的 RTX PC；现在 Perplexity 在 Windows 版 Perplexity app 中加入 Portable Computer，面向兼容的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX PC 和 NVIDIA RTX PRO Workstation，把强大的 agentic AI 带给更多 Windows PC 用户。

在技术原理与创新点上，Portable Computer 将本地与云端 AI 整合在同一个应用中。用户可以在 PC 上处理敏感文件，并使用 Computer 的内置工具，例如内置浏览器和专有 SPACE 沙盒。对于需要更高级推理的任务，Portable Computer 能识别任务是否需要云支持，并在把信息发送到设备外之前请求用户许可。设置过程也被简化：应用内置本地模型，例如经过后训练、可与 Perplexity Computer 配合的 Qwen 3.8 27B，并针对 NVIDIA RTX GPU 优化。用户无需自行研究模型或配置运行本地 AI 通常所需的复杂软件栈。Outlook、OneDrive、Word、Google Drive、Gmail、Slack 和 GitHub 等连接器进一步把体验扩展到用户日常工作流中的文件和应用。

从性能参数与配置看，原文未披露具体延迟、吞吐或基准分数，但给出了关键支持条件：Portable Computer 可在显存 24GB 或以上的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 和 RTX PRO GPU 上使用，NVIDIA DGX Station 支持预计很快到来。该版本建立在已有对 NVIDIA DGX Spark 系统和 Linux RTX PC 的支持之上，表明 NVIDIA 正推动本地 AI agent 从个人 RTX PC 扩展到工作站和 DGX 系统。原文还强调本地完成工作不消耗 Perplexity Computer 积分，而需要高级推理时可转交云模型，这形成了隐私、成本与能力之间的混合编排对比。

应用场景方面，Perplexity 给出几类示例：工程团队可让 agent 审查连接的 GitHub 项目中未合并的 pull request，按状态整理并识别下一步；Computer 还能标记过时文档并提交建议更新供审核。金融场景中，用户可让 Computer 处理两年券商摘要、合并 1099 表和税表，追踪造成最多可避免费用和税负拖累的经常性持仓，每个数字都引用到具体文件和页码，且文档不会发送给聊天机器人。初创团队可询问“激活为什么停滞”，agent 在本地分析漏斗导出数据，找出新注册用户在安装到首次完成任务之间的流失点，并把关键洞察直接发布到团队 Slack 频道。这些例子显示，Portable Computer 面向隐私敏感、跨文件、多步骤和重复性知识工作。

此外，NVIDIA 还汇总了本地 AI 生态的最新更新：Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 Flash 以低成本提供出色性能和视觉智能，针对 DGX Station 和双 DGX Spark 系统优化；DeepSeek-v4.1 Flash 显著降低复杂 AI agent 工作负载的键值缓存内存需求和运营成本，提升“每美元智能”；Qwen 发布开放权重多模态混合专家模型 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，以及 Qwen4 早期预览，后者可在单台 DGX Spark 上通过 NVFP4 本地运行，表现超出其体量；GLM 5.3 是 Z.ai 的 7440 亿参数旗舰模型，面向在 DGX Station 和四台 DGX Spark 集群上运行数小时的 agent 会话。整体来看，Perplexity Portable Computer 的发布是 NVIDIA 本地 AI 战略的一部分：把 agentic AI 从云端延伸到 Windows RTX PC、工作站和 DGX 系统，在隐私、成本和云端高级推理之间提供可编排的平衡。

items.title: Proven 8-pin PCIe plugs aren't immune to melting — Thermal Grizzly WireView adapter burns out on Radeon RX 7900 XTX
items.description: Three 8-pin connectors on a Thermal Grizzly WireView reportedly suffered burning and melting while connected to a Radeon RX 7900 XTX, with the company now investigating what caused the failure.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 16 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you believe that the 8-pin PCIe power connector is entirely immune to the problems that have plagued the newer 16-pin connector, think again. A recent incident suggests that even the humble 8-pin is not entirely immune to failure. According to a Radeon RX 7900 XTX owner on Reddit, the 8-pin connectors on a Thermal Grizzly WireView monitoring device suffered overheating damage while connected to the graphics card.The user said that they experienced frequent freezes and black screens before discovering the damage. The affected connectors were the 8-pin connectors on the GPU side of the monitoring device, with visible signs of burning and melted plastic. The user also confirmed that the connectors were fully inserted, although the exact cause of the failure is still unknown.WireView is essentially an adapter that sits between a graphics card and the power cables, allowing users to monitor various values like power consumption, voltages, current in amperes, minimum and maximum power consumption, and more. Rather than connecting the PSU cables directly to the GPU, the power passes through the monitoring device, thus adding another set of connectors and electrical contacts to the power delivery path. A poor electrical connection, increased contact resistance, a damaged connector, or an issue with the adapter itself could have caused the overheating damage.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Thermal Grizzly previously pointed to improper seating, backplate interference, or incorrectly aligned or soldered contacts as possible causes of connector damage, although the company is yet to identify the cause of this particular incident. The company has reportedly contacted the affected user and asked them to get in touch with its support team so the company can investigate the damaged WireView adapter. The investigation could potentially help determine whether the failure originated from the adapter, the connectors, the GPU, or a combination of factors.While we are on the subject of 8-pin power connectors, just days ago we saw a heavily modified RTX 5090 successfully running on traditional 8-pin connectors. The modders replaced the card's original 16-pin connectors with three 8-pin connectors soldered directly to the PCB, using heavy-gauge cables and modified sense pins. The card reportedly pulled as much as 900W and reached 3,400 MHz, demonstrating how capable 8-pin connectors can be when properly implemented. However, this was an extreme hardware modification, not a stock configuration. items.titleZh: Proven 8-pin PCIe plugs aren't immune to melting — Thermal Grizzly WireView adapter burns out on Radeon RX 7900 XTX
items.descriptionZh:
近日，Tom's Hardware报道了一起与8-pin PCIe供电接口有关的过热损坏事件，打破了“传统8-pin接口完全不受16-pin熔化问题影响”的常见印象。一位Reddit上的Radeon RX 7900 XTX用户在显卡与Thermal Grizzly WireView功耗监控适配器之间使用8-pin连接，随后频繁遇到死机、黑屏，检查后发现WireView朝向GPU一侧的8-pin接口出现烧灼和塑料熔化。用户确认接口已完全插紧，但具体故障原因仍未确定。

背景方面，新一代16-pin显卡供电接口曾因熔化、烧毁问题引发广泛关注，许多玩家因此认为成熟、久经考验的8-pin接口更安全。此次事件表明，8-pin也并非绝对免疫，尤其是在供电路径中加入了转接、延长或监控设备之后。问题未必来自8-pin标准本身，而可能来自额外增加的连接环节。

WireView本质上是一个串联在显卡和电源线之间的监测适配器。电源不是直接接入显卡，而是先经过WireView，再进入GPU。它可以监测功耗、电压、电流安培数、最小和最大功耗等数据。由于供电链路中多了一组连接器和电气接触点，也就多了一个潜在故障点。若出现电气接触不良、接触电阻升高、连接器损坏或适配器本身异常，在大电流下就可能产生局部高温，最终导致过热损坏。Thermal Grizzly此前曾将不当插入、背板干涉、接触件未对准或焊接不良列为连接器损坏的可能原因，但本次事件的直接原因仍待调查。公司已联系受影响用户，并要求其联系支持团队，以便对损坏的WireView适配器进行检测，从而判断故障源头是适配器、连接器、GPU，还是多种因素共同作用。

作为对比，就在数天前，有改装者成功让一块重度改装的RTX 5090使用传统8-pin接口运行。他们将显卡原装的16-pin接口替换为三个直接焊接在PCB上的8-pin接口，并使用粗线规电缆和修改过的sense pins。该卡据称功耗高达900W，频率达到3400 MHz，说明8-pin接口在正确实施的情况下仍具备很强的供电能力。不过，这属于极端硬件改装，并非原厂配置，普通用户不能将其等同于常规使用环境。

这一事件的技术影响在于，它提醒高端显卡用户和厂商：随着显卡功耗不断攀升，供电接口、转接线、监控适配器都可能成为系统薄弱点。WireView等监控工具虽然方便玩家掌握功耗、电压和电流状况，适合超频和功耗分析场景，但也会增加供电路径的复杂度和接触电阻风险。对于普通用户，应确保接口完全插入，避免背板干涉，使用质量可靠的线材和适配器，并留意异常发热、死机或黑屏等征兆。对于厂商，则需要进一步调查故障机制，并改进连接器和适配器设计。相关报道还包括改装RTX 5090放弃16-pin改用三8-pin、改装者将电源线直接焊到RTX 5090 PCB以消除熔化隐患，以及有爱好者称DLSS 5使RTX 5090功耗超过600W并熔化16-pin连接器等，均反映出当前高端显卡供电接口仍是需要重点关注的风险环节。

items.title: Maryland data center developers offer residents biggest-ever US community benefits package as big tech seeks to quell fears — $110 million deal includes $30 million elementary school, water reclamation system, and more
items.description: A new report claims AI data center builders are getting more savvy about offering communities tangible benefits to get their projects approved.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Residents of Frederick County, Maryland, could be the beneficiaries of what is purported to be the biggest residential benefits package yet to be offered by data center developers, in a move a new report claims is a sign of a growing trend that Big Tech is trying to get ahead of fears and community pushback surrounding AI infrastructure. The $110 million deal includes new schools, water reclamation, and more, The Information reports. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleAccording to the report, the Frederick Digital Campus offering could be a sign that data center developers like Amazon, Microsoft, and Oracle are wising up to growing residential pushback and concerns around the building of large AI data centers in their communities, with developers "sweetening financial offers to municipalities and regulators to gain approval for new facilities" while "getting smarter" about ensuring they shoulder the cost of utilities like electricity. The report says AI builders are turning towards tangible benefits, rather than rhetoric, to get their projects approved.The Maryland site, if approved, would see residents of Frederick County benefit from a $110 million investment in total, including a $30 million elementary school, $40 million of recreational facilities, a $14.5 million workforce training center, and a further $10.5 million for "agricultural preservation." That comes on top of a purported $215 million in annual property taxes the campus would pay upon completion, a 40% uptick in tax revenue.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: It appears the developers have also offered concessions regarding construction, reducing the square footage by almost 20%, and reducing potable water (water safe for human consumption and use) usage by 80%, with up to $100 million also proposed for a water reclamation system.The proposal is yet to be approved, but if passed, the campus would boast Amazon and Aligned Data centers amongst its tenants. The report reiterates the deal "reflects a rapidly emerging consensus by both tech companies and host governments to eliminate giveaways to developers and to accelerate benefits to towns in the vicinity of the facilities." You may like AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums Virginia county with 250 data centers begins to rein in building AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin quickly blocking new developments A further cited example from Pennsylvania claims AWS announced it would not seek any economic incentives to reduce the tax burden on its 4.5GW, 36-building data center campus in Homer City.The report further cites occasions where big tech companies are taking the side of consumers and residents over power rate debates, with Microsoft recently said to have challenged an American Transmission Co. and We Energies’ proposal for its Wisconsin data center, claiming the plan wasn't robust enough to protect retail customers from footing the bill if demand was lower than expected. In another case, Google and Amazon are said to have lobbied Virginia regulators to ensure they would fund transmission upgrades required for their infrastructure, rather than let an energy company cover the cost by marking up customer bills.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWith concerns around data center buildouts impacting local water supplies, energy rates, and even contributing to noise pollution, it's clear that Big Tech companies appear to be trying to grease the wheels on a local level by investing more directly in some local communities. Big Tech has reportedly now spent more than $1 trillion on AI infrastructure, so even local investments to the tune of hundreds of millions of dollars are a drop in the ocean for companies.Regulators are trying to pump the brakes on data center buildouts, with some 500 data centers on hold in the US because of various moratoriums and legal pauses. 据 The Information 报道，美国马里兰州弗雷德里克县居民可能将获得迄今为止数据中心开发商提供的最大规模居民利益方案。这份总额约 1.1 亿美元的协议包括新建学校、水回收系统等，被视为大型科技公司为应对 AI 基础设施引发的社区担忧和抵制而采取的新策略。随着 AI 数据中心对电力、水资源和土地的需求激增，居民越来越担心电价上涨、供水紧张、噪音污染以及地方税收和公用事业成本被转嫁，数据中心开发商正试图通过更直接、可量化的社区投资来换取项目审批。

拟议中的“弗雷德里克数字园区”若获批，将为弗雷德里克县带来 1.1 亿美元总投资，其中包括 3000 万美元的小学、4000 万美元的娱乐设施、1450 万美元的劳动力培训中心，以及 1050 万美元的农业保护资金。此外，园区建成后预计每年缴纳 2.15 亿美元财产税，使当地税收增加约 40%。开发商还提出建设方面的让步：建筑面积减少近 20%，饮用水用量减少 80%，并计划投入最高 1 亿美元建设水回收系统。该园区租户预计包括亚马逊和 Aligned Data Centers，但目前提案尚未获批。

这一案例反映出一种正在形成的共识：科技公司和地方政府都希望不再向数据中心开发商提供过多无偿优惠，而是加快让周边社区获得实际利益。报道认为，亚马逊、微软、甲骨文等公司正在“学聪明”，不仅向市政和监管机构提供更优厚的财务方案，还更重视承担电力等公用事业成本。换句话说，AI 基础设施开发商正从过去的公关话术，转向学校、培训、娱乐、农业保护和水资源回收等看得见的投入，以争取“社会许可”。

类似趋势还出现在其他地区。据报道，AWS 在宾夕法尼亚州 Homer City 规划了一个 4.5GW、36 栋建筑的数据中心园区，并宣布不寻求任何经济激励来减轻税收负担。微软则被指在威斯康星州挑战 American Transmission Co. 和 We Energies 的提案，认为该方案不足以保护零售客户，若数据中心需求低于预期，普通用户可能被迫承担费用。谷歌和亚马逊也在弗吉尼亚州游说监管机构，要求由自己资助其基础设施所需的输电升级，而不是让能源公司通过提高客户账单来覆盖成本。

从技术影响和应用场景看，AI 数据中心需要大规模、稳定的电力和冷却用水，因此其选址和扩建越来越受地方监管、能源价格和水资源约束。当前美国已有约 500 个数据中心因各类禁令、暂停令和法律程序被搁置，AI 数据中心禁令在全国范围内超过 500 起。大型科技公司已在 AI 基础设施上投入超过 1 万亿美元，因此即便数亿美元的本地投资对它们而言也只是“九牛一毛”。但这类投资可能成为未来数据中心项目审批的模板：通过承担公用事业升级成本、减少环境足迹、直接回馈社区，来降低地方反对风险。若该模式推广，数据中心开发商的项目成本可能上升，但审批确定性和社区关系有望改善；若无法平息居民担忧，地方禁令和暂停政策仍可能继续增加。

items.title: Dumpster diver builds home lab Proxmox server from weekly landfill runs for SSDs, HDDs, GPUs, and even RAM — weekly e-waste raids net multi-drive Proxmox server and Asus ROG laptop
items.description: A tech enthusiast says that they managed to put together a home lab-worthy Proxmox server using PC parts scavenged from the nearby county landfill.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A tech enthusiast says that they managed to put together a home lab-worthy Proxmox server using PC parts scavenged from the nearby county landfill. Furthermore, Tsuto told fellow Redditors that they now routinely raid the dump’s separate electronics recycling area once a week. We can’t blame them; their gallery of liberated hardware includes plenty of valuable trinkets like SSDs, HDDs, GPUs, even RAM, complete laptops, and more.The county landfill has a separate bin for electronics and I’ve taken to raiding it once a week to scavenge for parts for my labs. from r/homelab‘It’s wild what people throw away these days,’ says the successful tech scavenger. Tsuto seems to admit that many of the bits and pieces are “on the older end,” but even folks paying cold, hard cash at retail in 2026 are competing for components like RTX 3060s, AM4 motherboards/CPUs, and DDR4. That’s how hard the components shortage is hitting folks.Tsuto also seems rather pleased with an Asus ROG laptop found at the landfill site. “The Asus ROG laptop just needed a $25 battery off Amazon and still has decent enough specs for casual gaming for my son,” they comment. Pixel peeping Tsuto’s gallery indicates that this portable gaming laptop packs an Intel Core i7-4710HQ (4C/8T) supported by 16GB of RAM, and allied with a GeForce GTX 860M 2GB GPU. It will be playing less demanding titles such as Stumble Guys, we see.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: In a follow-up post, the Redditor explains that one of their home lab projects that has been built from the dumpster finds includes a Proxmox server. It’s a dusty-looking machine (it’s a shame Tsuto hasn’t found an air duster yet?), but it is ample for their needs. The ‘new’ Proxmox machine is said to pack in “Two mirrored 256GB SSDs for the OS, one extra 1TB SSD for fast storage, and three 2TB HDDs in RAID1 for ZFS storage.”Despite the lavish tech finds from this landfill, Tsuto says they actually bought some key components off Amazon to finalize the system – a Core i7-7700 and 64GB of RAM. We hope the RAM wasn’t bought in recent months, with the prices as they are. items.titleZh: Dumpster diver builds home lab Proxmox server from weekly landfill runs for SSDs, HDDs, GPUs, and even RAM — weekly e-waste raids net multi-drive Proxmox server and Asus ROG laptop
items.descriptionZh:
Reddit 用户 Tsuto 在 r/homelab 版块分享称，自己从附近县垃圾填埋场的电子废弃物回收区淘零件，组装出一台足以用于家庭实验室的 Proxmox 服务器。他如今每周都会去该填埋场专门存放电子产品的区域“寻宝”。在 2026 年 PC 组件短缺、内存价格高企的背景下，这一做法尤其引人关注：文章指出，即使是 RTX 3060、AM4 主板/CPU、DDR4 内存等上一代产品，零售市场仍有人在抢购，说明组件供应紧张已让废弃硬件重新具备可观价值。Tsuto 的收获包括 SSD、HDD、GPU、内存、完整笔记本等，他感叹“现在人们扔的东西太疯狂了”。

具体来看，Tsuto 找到的一台 Asus ROG 游戏笔记本只需从亚马逊花 25 美元买一块电池就能使用。该笔记本配置为 Intel Core i7-4710HQ（4 核 8 线程）、16GB 内存和 GeForce GTX 860M 2GB 显卡，性能虽老，但足以让他儿子玩《Stumble Guys》这类要求不高的休闲游戏。另一项核心成果是用垃圾场零件搭建的 Proxmox 服务器：两个 256GB SSD 以镜像方式安装操作系统，一个额外 1TB SSD 用作快速存储，三个 2TB HDD 以 RAID1/镜像方式组成 ZFS 存储池。尽管大量零件来自填埋场，他仍从亚马逊购买了关键部件——Core i7-7700 和 64GB 内存，以最终完成系统。文章还调侃称，希望这 64GB 内存不是最近几个月买的，因为当前内存价格很高。

从技术原理看，Proxmox VE 是基于 Debian 的开源虚拟化平台，集成 KVM 虚拟机与 LXC 容器，适合家庭实验室、自托管和开发测试。ZFS 则是集文件系统与卷管理于一体的存储方案，支持写时复制、快照、校验、压缩和镜像/RAID 等能力；RAID1 通过多盘镜像提供冗余，但会牺牲容量利用率。三块 2TB HDD 做镜像可理解为三路镜像，可用容量约等于单块 2TB，却能容忍多盘故障。两个 256GB SSD 镜像保证系统盘可靠性，1TB SSD 提升虚拟机或热数据性能，HDD 则承担大容量 ZFS 存储，形成典型的分层存储。Core i7-7700 为 4 核 8 线程，搭配 64GB 内存，虽在单核性能、能效和 PCIe 通道上落后现代平台，但对运行多台虚拟机、容器和 NAS/媒体服务已足够；ZFS 还可能利用空闲内存作 ARC 缓存，因此大内存对存储性能也有帮助。

这一案例的技术影响不在发明新架构，而在于把企业级虚拟化与存储栈——Proxmox、ZFS、RAID1、SSD/HDD 分层——与废弃消费硬件结合，形成低成本、可持续的家庭云方案。其应用场景包括家庭实验室、虚拟化测试、自托管服务、NAS、媒体服务器、轻量游戏和儿童娱乐等。文章还列出类似案例：有人在车库发现价值 12,000 美元的 RAM，有人在 30 美元扩展卡中发现价值 1,500 美元的三星 SSD，还有人回收到 12 块矿潮时期的 RTX 3070。这些例子都说明电子废弃物中可能潜藏高价值硬件。不过，文章也提醒，并非所有地方都能随意从回收中心取走电子产品，一些回收站配有安保和摄像头，想“淘垃圾”仍需遵守当地法规与回收站规定。总体而言，在硬件短缺和涨价周期中，旧硬件的二次利用既具经济价值，也有减少电子垃圾的环保意义。

history.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a call from President Trump on Monday while onstage at the All-In Podcast’s All-In Summit. It’s not the first time Huang has taken a call from the president during work, but this time he put Trump on speakerphone before a big crowd.During the call, the president launched into his take on recent fears about AI development, which he called a “hoax,” and told the crowd that “the robots will not be taking over.”It’s already a frothy week for AI news. The call with the president followed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s long essay published this weekend titled “We Must Pace the Frontier” where he argued for slowing down AI development and coordination between governments. The essay sparked many responses from AI executives, who generally agreed. But Trump pushed back in Truth Social posts on Monday and repurposed some of what he said in those posts at the event. Heard onstage, Trump also commented on data centers, claiming there would be communities that would be “dying” without data centers but were now “really wealthy” (though without providing specifics).Huang did not push back, saying instead that “We’re going to make sure that everybody wins in the AI race in America. Every industry, every company, every state, every people.” Huang also appealed to Trump by telling him he was speaking to “thousands” of people.You can hear all of Trump’s comments in recordings of the appearance on X:

history.titleZh: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world
history.descriptionZh:
在All-In播客的All-In峰会上，Nvidia CEO黄仁勋在台上时接到了特朗普总统的电话。这并非黄仁勋第一次在工作中接听总统来电，但这次他将特朗普设为免提模式，让在场众多观众都能听到对话。通话中，特朗普总统阐述了他对近期AI发展担忧的看法，称其为“骗局”，并向观众表示“机器人不会接管世界”。

本周AI新闻本就热闹非凡。这通总统来电之前，Anthropic CEO达里奥·阿莫代伊于本周末发表了一篇题为《我们必须把握前沿节奏》的长文，主张放缓AI发展速度并呼吁各国政府之间进行协调。该文引发了众多AI高管的回应，他们普遍表示认同。但特朗普周一在Truth Social上发文反驳，并在活动中部分重复了这些帖子的内容。在台上，特朗普还谈到了数据中心，声称有些社区如果没有数据中心就会“消亡”，但现在却“非常富有”（不过未提供具体细节）。

黄仁勋并未反驳，而是表示：“我们将确保在美国的AI竞赛中每个人都是赢家。每个行业、每家公司、每个州、每个人。”黄仁勋还迎合特朗普，告诉他自己正在对“数千”人讲话。

history.title: Nvidia's RTX 5090 vanishes from online retail in the US — third-party sellers now demand as much as $9,500 for Nvidia's fastest GPU
history.description: The RTX 5090 is out of stock from first-party sellers online in the U.S., with third-party sellers now asking for as much as $9,500 for the GPU.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's fastest gaming graphics card, the RTX 5090, has been on a tear of price increases over the past several weeks. However, over the past week, the available inventory has dwindled. Now, you can only find the RTX 5090 from third-party sellers at online retailers like Newegg and Amazon, commanding anywhere from $6,500 to $9,500 (or even higher) for Team Green's best GPU.Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs (Image credit: Noctua)Desktop GPU RoadmapNvidia's Enterprise GPU RoadmapTesting DirectStorage with GPU decompressionThe GeForce RTX 30-series upgrade matrix — does your Ampere GPU need an upgrade in 2026?Rubin in-depthThe Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PCAt Newegg, the cheapest RTX 5090 is the MSI Ventus 3X that's available from Slava Computers (a relatively new seller with 239 ratings and a 2.8 out of 5 rating at the time of writing) for $6,449. On Amazon, you can get the Asus TUF Gaming OC for $6,395 from Joes Tech Shop, a seller with an 81% positive rating. However, among the most recent reviews are a string of one-star reviews about orders never being fulfilled. The cost goes much higher, as well. The first result for "RTX 5090" on Newegg, for example, surfaces the MSI Ventus 3X OC for $8,699.In June, the median price for an RTX 5090 was $4,299. At the beginning of September, we logged the lowest online price at $5,199 in our GPU price tracker. Now, in less than two weeks, the available stock has completely disappeared online, and the options available from third-party sellers have ballooned in price once again.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Naturally, we don't recommend buying from one of these third-party sellers. The RTX 5090 is selling at a vastly inflated price, but more importantly, we've seen no shortage of scams around high-ticket items like the RTX 5090. In January, 42 Amazon customers were duped into a scam involving a $999 RTX 5090, instead receiving a fanny pack in place of the GPU. Earlier this month, an online seller scammed two buyers with the RTX 5090, selling phantom graphics cards with the core and memory removed on the secondhand market for prices near MSRP.The one exception to RTX 5090 inventory is Micro Center, which still has cards available around the average selling price. At a local Micro Center we checked, the cheapest in-stock option was $4,299. Micro Center has exclusively sold graphics cards in-person for several years, insulating it from online buyouts like what appears to be going on right now. history.titleZh: Nvidia's RTX 5090 vanishes from online retail in the US — third-party sellers now demand as much as $9,500 for Nvidia's fastest GPU
history.descriptionZh:
Nvidia 旗下最快的游戏显卡 GeForce RTX 5090 正遭遇严重缺货和价格失控。过去数周，RTX 5090 的价格持续上涨；过去一周，线上库存进一步枯竭。目前在 Newegg、Amazon 等在线零售商处，RTX 5090 基本只能通过第三方卖家购买，报价约在 6,500 至 9,500 美元甚至更高。

具体来看，Newegg 上最便宜的 RTX 5090 是 MSI Ventus 3X，由 Slava Computers 出售，价格为 6,449 美元；该卖家相对较新，当时仅有 239 条评价，评分 2.8/5。Amazon 上 Asus TUF Gaming OC 由 Joes Tech Shop 出售，价格 6,395 美元，卖家好评率为 81%，但近期评论中出现多起未发货的一星投诉。Newegg 搜索“RTX 5090”的首个结果则是 MSI Ventus 3X OC，价格高达 8,699 美元。作为对比，今年 6 月 RTX 5090 的中位价为 4,299 美元，9 月初 Tom's Hardware 价格追踪记录到的最低线上价格为 5,199 美元；不到两周后，线上库存完全消失，第三方卖家价格再次膨胀。

Tom's Hardware 明确不建议从这些第三方卖家购买。除了价格严重虚高，RTX 5090 这类高单价商品还频繁出现诈骗。今年 1 月，42 名 Amazon 顾客在一场 999 美元 RTX 5090 骗局中受骗，收到的不是显卡而是腰包；本月早些时候，还有线上卖家在二手市场以接近建议零售价的价格出售被拆掉核心和显存的“空壳显卡”，两名买家上当。唯一例外是 Micro Center，该零售商仍有接近平均售价的库存，当地门店检查到的最便宜现货为 4,299 美元。Micro Center 多年来只在线下销售显卡，因此避免了被线上扫货和抢购潮冲击。

RTX 5090 需求如此旺盛的核心原因仍是 AI。该卡搭载 GB202 GPU 和 32GB GDDR7 显存。相比之下，Nvidia RTX Pro 5000 48GB 使用相同 GPU，但启用的着色器单元比 RTX 5090 少约三分之一，显存带宽也更低，售价却在 7,000 至 9,000 美元之间。在这一背景下，即使 RTX 5090 单价达到 5,000 美元甚至更高，用于搭建 AI 服务器也显得有吸引力。

与此同时，根据 Tom's Hardware GPU 基准测试层级，RTX 5090 仍是市场上最快的游戏显卡。随着 Nvidia 推出 DLSS 5 神经渲染，RTX 5090 能充分利用这一 AI 渲染技术；不过 Tom's Hardware 的广泛测试也发现，较低端显卡同样能达到可玩性能。Tom's Hardware 已联系 Nvidia，询问其是否有稳定库存的计划，若获得回复将更新报道。

history.description: Nvidia launches the RTX Pro 5500 Blackwell Workstation Edition graphics card for agentic and generative AI.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The GeForce RTX 5090 is undeniably one of the best graphics cards money can buy. Banking on the fact that many already use it for AI, Nvidia has bolstered it with even more memory and launched it as the new RTX 5500 Pro Blackwell Workstation Edition. It offers comparable specifications to the GeForce RTX 5090 but distinguishes itself with 84GB of GDDR7 memory, 2.6X more than the Blackwell gaming flagship.Go deeper with TH Premium: GPUs (Image credit: Noctua)Desktop GPU RoadmapNvidia's Enterprise GPU RoadmapTesting DirectStorage with GPU decompressionThe GeForce RTX 30-series upgrade matrix — does your Ampere GPU need an upgrade in 2026?Rubin in-depthThe Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PCThe RTX Pro 5500 features the GB202 silicon, the powerhouse die that powers other high-end mainstream and professional Blackwell graphics cards, including the GeForce RTX 5090, RTX Pro 6000, and RTX Pro 5000. In fact, the RTX Pro 5500 uses the same die as the GeForce RTX 5090, which means 170 Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) are enabled out of a possible 192. As a result, the RTX Pro 5500 has 21,760 CUDA cores and offers performance comparable to the GeForce RTX 5090. The differentiator is the memory subsystem, where the RTX Pro 5500 excels.Nvidia equipped the RTX Pro 5500 with 84GB of GDDR7 memory. This is the second time Nvidia has launched a graphics card with 84GB of memory, with the first being the China-exclusive RTX Pro 6000D. The RTX Pro 5500's memory capacity lets the Blackwell graphics card sit comfortably between the RTX Pro 5000 and the upgraded RTX Pro 6000, with 72GB and 96GB of GDDR7 memory, respectively.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 Workstation Edition Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Graphics Card RTX Pro 6000 RTX Pro 6000D RTX Pro 5500 RTX 5090 RTX Pro 5000 Architecture GB202 GB202 GB202 GB202 GB202 Process Technology TSMC 4N TSMC 4N TSMC 4N TSMC 4N TSMC 4N Transistors (Billion) 92.2 92.2 92.2 92.2 92.2 Die size (mm^2) 750 750 750 750 750 SMs 188 156 170 170 110 CUDA Cores 24,064 19,968 21,760 21,760 14,080 Tensor Cores 752 624 680 680 440 Ray Tracing Cores 188 156 176 176 110 Boost Clock (MHz) 2,617 2,430 ? 2,407 2,617 VRAM Speed (Gbps) 28 25 25 28 28 VRAM (GB) 96 84 84 32 48 / 72 VRAM Bus Width 512 448 448 512 384 L2 Cache 128 128 96 96 96 Render Output Units 192 192 192 176 176 Texture Mapping Units 752 624 680 680 440 TFLOPS FP32 (Boost) 126.0 97.04 ? 104.8 73.69 Bandwidth (GB/s) 1,792 1,400 1,398 1,790 1,344 TBP (watts) 600 600 600 575 300 Nvidia achieved the 84GB memory capacity by outfitting the RTX Pro 5500 with 28 GDDR7 memory chips in a clamshell configuration. Each side of the PCB houses 14 24Gb (3GB) GDDR7 memory modules. They run at 25 Gb/s across a 448-bit memory interface, delivering up to 1,400 GB/s of bandwidth, which aligns with Nvidia’s official specification of 1,398 GB/s. In other words, the RTX Pro 5500 shares the same memory subsystem as the RTX Pro 6000D.Samsung, Micron, and SK hynix only produce standard 28 Gb/s memory packages. Therefore, Nvidia downclocks the RTX Pro 5500's GDDR7 chips for its own reasons, whether to meet thermal and power targets or avoid cannibalizing higher-tier SKUs. From a memory-bandwidth perspective, the RTX Pro 5500 is not particularly impressive. Its bandwidth is only 4% ahead of the RTX Pro 5000, and it lags 22% behind both the flagship RTX Pro 6000 and the GeForce RTX 5090, which fully leverage 28 Gb/s GDDR7 memory chips. Nvidia's main motivation was to launch the RTX Pro 5500 to fill the large performance and pricing gap between the RTX Pro 6000 and RTX Pro 5000. Also, the chipmaker makes substantially more profit by putting recycled GB202 into an RTX Pro 5500 than into a GeForce RTX 5090. By giving the former more memory with similar core specifications as the latter, Nvidia seemingly hopes to win more customers over to the RTX Pro 5500.We reached out to both Nvidia and PNY for official pricing on the RTX Pro 5500, but neither company has responded. For reference, the flagship RTX Pro 6000 retails for $15,599, while an RTX Pro 5000 72GB starts at $9,209. history.titleZh: Gaming takes a backseat as Nvidia overhauls the RTX 5090 for maximum AI margins — RTX Pro 5500 delivers 2.6X VRAM at matching specs
history.descriptionZh:
Nvidia 近日推出 RTX Pro 5500 Blackwell 工作站版显卡，本质上是把 GeForce RTX 5090 的核心规格与更大显存结合，面向 AI 和专业工作站市场。RTX 5090 已被广泛用于 AI 任务，Nvidia 借此基础将其强化为专业产品，显存从 32GB 提升到 84GB GDDR7，达到游戏旗舰的 2.6 倍，填补 RTX Pro 6000 与 RTX Pro 5000 之间的性能与价格空档。

核心方面，RTX Pro 5500 采用 GB202 芯片，与 RTX 5090、RTX Pro 6000、RTX Pro 5000 同源。其 192 个流式多处理器（SM）中启用 170 个，提供 21,760 个 CUDA 核心、680 个 Tensor 核心、176 个光线追踪核心、96MB L2 缓存、192 个 ROP 和 680 个 TMU，总板功耗 600W。Boost 频率和 FP32 算力尚未公布，但核心规模与 RTX 5090 基本一致，计算性能预计接近。区别主要在显存子系统：RTX Pro 5500 配备 84GB GDDR7，通过 clamshell 夹层配置实现，PCB 两面各焊 14 颗 24Gb（3GB）GDDR7 芯片，共 28 颗，搭配 448-bit 位宽，显存速率 25 Gb/s，带宽约 1,398 GB/s。这与 RTX Pro 6000D 的显存子系统相同，也是 Nvidia 第二次推出 84GB 显存显卡，首次是中国特供的 RTX Pro 6000D。

对比来看，RTX Pro 6000 拥有 96GB GDDR7、512-bit 位宽、28 Gb/s、1,792 GB/s 带宽、188 SM、24,064 CUDA 核心、752 Tensor 核心，FP32 算力 126 TFLOPS，TBP 600W，售价 15,599 美元。RTX Pro 6000D 为 84GB、448-bit、25 Gb/s、1,400 GB/s 带宽、156 SM、19,968 CUDA 核心、624 Tensor 核心、97.04 TFLOPS，TBP 600W。RTX Pro 5000 提供 48GB 或 72GB、384-bit、28 Gb/s、1,344 GB/s 带宽、110 SM、14,080 CUDA 核心、440 Tensor 核心、73.69 TFLOPS，TBP 300W，72GB 版起价 9,209 美元。RTX 5090 则是 32GB、512-bit、28 Gb/s、1,790 GB/s 带宽、170 SM、21,760 CUDA 核心、680 Tensor 核心、104.8 TFLOPS，TBP 575W。

RTX Pro 5500 的显存带宽并不突出：仅比 RTX Pro 5000 高约 4%，却比 RTX Pro 6000 和 RTX 5090 低约 22%。原因是三星、美光、SK 海力士只生产标准 28 Gb/s GDDR7 封装，Nvidia 将其降频至 25 Gb/s，可能是为了满足散热与功耗目标，或避免蚕食更高阶 SKU。总体而言，RTX Pro 5500 像是 RTX Pro 6000D 与 RTX 5090 的结合体：核心规格接近 5090，显存容量看齐 6000D。Nvidia 的动机包括填补产品线空白、利用回收的 GB202 芯片获取比游戏卡更高的利润，并以大显存吸引 AI 客户。官方价格尚未公布，Nvidia 和 PNY 也未回应询问；参考 RTX Pro 6000 的 15,599 美元和 RTX Pro 5000 72GB 的 9,209 美元，RTX Pro 5500 预计定价在这两者之间。该卡适合需要超大显存进行大模型推理、AI 训练或专业可视化的工作站用户，但在显存带宽敏感型任务中并不占优。

history.title: Nvidia, Palantir, and others restrict advanced AI model usage over privacy concerns, report claims — 'paranoia' rising over customer intellectual property
history.description: Companies are concerned that their intellectual property may be used by Anthropic and OpenAI to help improve their AI models.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Anthropic and OpenAI are both facing uncomfortable questions from some large AI customers over concerns about how proprietary data may be used to train AI models. Some companies are so worried that they have begun demanding assurances about how their data is handled or going so far as to place limitations on which models their employees can use, and for which tasks, The Information reports. They fear that models may be trained on their intellectual property and information.The issue can be traced back to a June change by Anthropic. Following the change to its flagship Fable model's policies, Anthropic can now retain customer data. The company argues that it only does so to ensure that Fable isn't being misused. But some companies have raised concerns that it means sensitive business data will be caught up in the sweep.While both OpenAI and Anthropic point out that they don't train their models on the information given to them by companies with specific enterprise contracts by default, that doesn't tell the full story. Both companies do collect metadata from the same corporate customers, and while information on exactly what that metadata contains is hard to come by, OpenAI notes that it's only used “to better understand how our services are used." Anthropic also argues that any data it collects about how customers use its products is aggregated and anonymized. And that metadata isn't used to train models.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Regardless, there are still concerns over a perceived lack of clarity about what is collected. Telecoms outfit C Spire has agreements with both OpenAI and Anthropic that prevent either from using its data to train models, the report says.However, the contracts do allow both OpenAI and Anthropic to collect C Spire technical usage data. C Spire believes that includes information about what applications AI models are connected to as well as usage data. It also worries that the AI companies may collect information about what their models get up to between generating responses. You may like Palantir CEO Alex Karp claims AI companies are stealing customers' data while charging them for unproductive tokens OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic absent from Nvidia-led Open Secure AI Alliance Nvidia and 24 other companies sign open-weights letter as Washington weighs Chinese AI model ban For its part, OpenAI says that it does not use this "chain-of-thought" data to train its models. But C Spire still believes it needs a better understanding of what data is being collected, the report adds. It argues that neither AI company is being clear in its explanations.Taking the private approachOne solution to any privacy concerns could be to use air-gapped servers, something aerospace company Northrop Grumman has already chosen to do. The Information reports that the company runs open-source AI models on its own air-gapped servers rather than trusting the likes of OpenAI and Anthropic.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsAlternatively, Microsoft is already trying to take advantage of any data privacy concerns by tempting OpenAI and Anthropic customers to its own secure AI platforms. Microsoft's isolated cloud environments run AI models on private servers that don't send any data to external AI companies. But this approach is costly, and the report notes that at least one customer is still considering Microsoft's alternative approach.Pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk has taken a slightly different approach. While it continues to use Anthropic's Claude for some tasks, it has a ban on allowing any proprietary data to be used by the model.It's clear that a lack of trust has the potential to cost AI companies real money, and in one instance, it already has. The same report notes that a large U.S. utility company has already canceled its plans to test Anthropic's Fable. The utility company wanted to know if Fable could run its core power infrastructure but ultimately pulled the plug over Anthropic's refusal to agree to a nonrevocable zero data retention (ZDR) policy.Nvidia has also decided to use Fable for tasks that don't require it to gain access to sensitive data. The company points to the same lack of ZDR guarentees as the reason. Instead, Nvidia uses its own in-house AI solution for tasks that it deems too sensitive for Anthropic's model. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has famously remarked that its employees should use AI tokens worth half their annual salary every year.Toms Hardware reached out to Nvidia for comment but did not receive one by publication. history.titleZh: Nvidia, Palantir, and others restrict advanced AI model usage over privacy concerns, report claims — 'paranoia' rising over customer intellectual property
history.descriptionZh:
Anthropic与OpenAI正面临来自部分大型企业AI客户的尖锐质询：这些客户担心自己的专有数据可能被用于训练AI模型。The Information报道称，一些公司已开始要求AI厂商就数据处理方式作出保证，甚至限制员工可以使用哪些模型、用于哪些任务。它们担心自身知识产权和商业信息被模型学习。这一问题可追溯至Anthropic在6月对其旗舰Fable模型政策所作的调整。调整后，Anthropic可以保留客户数据。公司称保留数据仅是为了确保Fable不被滥用，但部分企业担心敏感业务数据会被纳入留存范围。OpenAI和Anthropic均表示，对于签署特定企业合同的客户，默认不会用其提供的信息训练模型。然而报道指出，这并未呈现全貌：两家公司仍会从这些企业客户处收集元数据。虽然元数据具体包含什么难以获知，但OpenAI称其仅用于“更好理解服务如何被使用”；Anthropic则称收集的客户使用数据经过聚合和匿名化，元数据不用于训练模型。尽管如此，企业客户仍认为数据收集范围缺乏明确性。

电信公司C Spire的案例具有代表性。它与OpenAI和Anthropic签有协议，阻止两家公司用其数据训练模型，但合同允许两家公司收集C Spire的“技术使用数据”。C Spire认为，这可能包括AI模型连接了哪些应用以及使用数据；它还担心AI公司会收集模型在生成回答“之间”的行为信息，即所谓的“思维链”数据。OpenAI表示不会用这种思维链数据训练模型，但C Spire仍认为需要更清楚地了解究竟收集了什么，并批评两家AI公司解释不够清晰。这里涉及的核心技术边界是：企业合同通常只承诺“不用提示和输出训练”，但使用日志、应用连接、中间推理步骤等是否属于训练或改进数据，往往模糊。对金融、电信、公用事业等敏感行业，这种模糊会直接触发合规和商业机密风险。

为规避风险，一些企业转向私有化方案。航空航天公司Northrop Grumman选择在自有的气隙服务器上运行开源AI模型，而不是信任OpenAI和Anthropic。所谓气隙，是服务器与外部网络物理隔离，数据不出本地，因而能最大限度防止专有信息流向外部AI厂商。微软则试图把这种担忧转化为商机，推出隔离云环境，在私有服务器上运行AI模型，不向外部AI公司发送任何数据。但该方案成本较高，报道称至少有一个客户仍在考虑是否采用。制药公司Novo Nordisk采取折中：继续用Anthropic的Claude处理部分任务，但禁止任何专有数据被模型使用。

信任缺失已经开始造成实际商业损失。报道称，一家美国大型公用事业公司原本计划测试Anthropic的Fable，以评估其能否运行核心电力基础设施，但最终取消，原因是Anthropic拒绝同意“不可撤销的零数据保留”（ZDR）政策。ZDR意味着服务商在请求处理后不存储任何客户数据，且承诺不可撤销；对于关键基础设施和国防等场景，这往往是采购前提。Nvidia也决定仅在不需要接触敏感数据的任务中使用Fable，原因同样是缺乏ZDR保证；对于过于敏感的任务，Nvidia改用自家内部AI方案。Nvidia CEO黄仁勋曾表示，员工每年应使用价值相当于其年薪一半的AI tokens。截至发稿，Nvidia未对Tom's Hardware的置评请求作出回应。

从对比看，报道没有给出模型性能、延迟、吞吐或成本等具体参数，核心是数据治理模式差异：OpenAI与Anthropic提供前沿模型能力，但默认企业合同只覆盖“不训练”，仍收集元数据和技术使用数据，且不轻易承诺不可撤销ZDR；Northrop Grumman式气隙部署最安全，但依赖开源模型和自有运维，可能无法直接获得最前沿闭源模型；微软隔离云在安全与便利间折中，但价格高；Novo Nordisk则通过禁止专有数据进入模型来限制风险。这些选择将影响企业AI落地：高敏感行业可能更多采用私有云、本地推理、开源模型和严格数据分区，从而推动本地AI基础设施和加速芯片需求；AI厂商则需在合同透明度、数据保留政策和ZDR上给出更强保证，否则可能失去大客户。整体而言，企业AI采购正从“模型能力优先”转向“能力与数据主权并重”，信任成为商业化的关键门槛。

history.title: Perplexity Portable Computer Is Now Available on Windows, Powered by NVIDIA RTX
history.description: As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device. Portable Computer is a local version of the agent Perplexity Computer that plans and carries out multistep tasks. Accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs, it uses local models to analyze data, bring together information […]
history.content: As local models become more capable, AI agents can handle more work directly on a PC while keeping sensitive information on the device. Portable Computer is a local version of the agent Perplexity Computer that plans and carries out multistep tasks. Accelerated by NVIDIA GPUs, it uses local models to analyze data, bring together information across files and handle recurring work. Sensitive information stays on device, and locally completed work doesn’t consume Perplexity Computer credits. Users can also orchestrate work up to cloud models for more advanced research and reasoning. Today, Perplexity is adding Portable Computer in the Perplexity app for Windows on compatible NVIDIA GeForce RTX PCs and NVIDIA RTX PRO Workstations, bringing powerful agentic AI to more Windows PC users. The release builds on existing support for NVIDIA DGX Spark systems and RTX PCs running Linux. Local Agents Powered by NVIDIA RTX Perplexity brings local and cloud AI together in one app, letting users work with sensitive files on their PCs and take advantage of Computer’s built-in tools such as the built-in browser and proprietary SPACE sandbox. For tasks that call for more advanced reasoning, Portable Computer can also identify when a task needs cloud support, asking the user for permission before sending information off-device. The app simplifies setup with a local model, such as Qwen 3.8 27B, that is post-trained to work with Perplexity Computer and optimized for NVIDIA RTX GPUs. Users can put the agent to work without having to research models or configure the complex software stack typically required to run local AI. Connectors for Microsoft Outlook, OneDrive, Word, Google Drive, Gmail, Slack and GitHub extend that experience across the files and apps already part of users’ daily workflows. For example, the agent can help with: Engineering: Review open pull requests in a connected GitHub project, organize them by status and identify next steps. Computer can also flag outdated documentation and submit proposed updates for review. Finance: Point Computer at two years of brokerage summaries, consolidated 1099s and tax returns, and have it trace the recurring holdings creating the most avoidable fees and tax drag, with every figure cited to the exact file and page — all without a document ever reaching a chatbot. Startups: Ask Computer why activation went flat, and the agent analyzes the funnel export locally to find where new signups drop off between install and first completed task, then posts the top insights straight to the team’s Slack channel. Try Portable Computer on Windows PCs Today Portable Computer is available for NVIDIA GeForce RTX and RTX PRO GPUs with 24GB or more of VRAM. NVIDIA DGX Station support is expected to come soon. Try Perplexity Portable Computer today. #ICYMI: The Latest Updates From NVIDIA Local AI 🧠Z.ai’s GLM 5.3 Flash provides impressive performance and visual intelligence at low cost, optimized for DGX Station and dual DGX Spark systems. 🐋DeepSeek-v4.1 Flash significantly reduces key-value cache memory demands and operating costs for complex AI agent workloads, delivering remarkable intelligence per dollar. ⚡Qwen has released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model, and an early preview of Qwen4, which can run locally on a single DGX Spark with NVFP4 and punches well above its weight. 👾GLM 5.3 is Z.ai’s 744-billion-parameter flagship model, tuned for agent sessions that run for hours on DGX Station and a cluster of four DGX Spark systems. history.titleZh: Perplexity Portable Computer Is Now Available on Windows, Powered by NVIDIA RTX
history.descriptionZh:
随着本地模型能力增强，AI agent 已能在 PC 上直接承担更多工作，同时把敏感信息留在设备端。Perplexity 宣布推出 Portable Computer——Perplexity Computer 的本地版本，可在 PC 上规划和执行多步任务。它由 NVIDIA GPU 加速，使用本地模型分析数据、汇总跨文件信息并处理重复性工作。敏感信息保留在设备上，本地完成的任务也不消耗 Perplexity Computer 积分。用户还可以把工作编排到云模型，以进行更高级的研究和推理。此前该能力已支持 NVIDIA DGX Spark 系统和运行 Linux 的 RTX PC；现在 Perplexity 在 Windows 版 Perplexity app 中加入 Portable Computer，面向兼容的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX PC 和 NVIDIA RTX PRO Workstation，把强大的 agentic AI 带给更多 Windows PC 用户。

在技术原理与创新点上，Portable Computer 将本地与云端 AI 整合在同一个应用中。用户可以在 PC 上处理敏感文件，并使用 Computer 的内置工具，例如内置浏览器和专有 SPACE 沙盒。对于需要更高级推理的任务，Portable Computer 能识别任务是否需要云支持，并在把信息发送到设备外之前请求用户许可。设置过程也被简化：应用内置本地模型，例如经过后训练、可与 Perplexity Computer 配合的 Qwen 3.8 27B，并针对 NVIDIA RTX GPU 优化。用户无需自行研究模型或配置运行本地 AI 通常所需的复杂软件栈。Outlook、OneDrive、Word、Google Drive、Gmail、Slack 和 GitHub 等连接器进一步把体验扩展到用户日常工作流中的文件和应用。

从性能参数与配置看，原文未披露具体延迟、吞吐或基准分数，但给出了关键支持条件：Portable Computer 可在显存 24GB 或以上的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 和 RTX PRO GPU 上使用，NVIDIA DGX Station 支持预计很快到来。该版本建立在已有对 NVIDIA DGX Spark 系统和 Linux RTX PC 的支持之上，表明 NVIDIA 正推动本地 AI agent 从个人 RTX PC 扩展到工作站和 DGX 系统。原文还强调本地完成工作不消耗 Perplexity Computer 积分，而需要高级推理时可转交云模型，这形成了隐私、成本与能力之间的混合编排对比。

应用场景方面，Perplexity 给出几类示例：工程团队可让 agent 审查连接的 GitHub 项目中未合并的 pull request，按状态整理并识别下一步；Computer 还能标记过时文档并提交建议更新供审核。金融场景中，用户可让 Computer 处理两年券商摘要、合并 1099 表和税表，追踪造成最多可避免费用和税负拖累的经常性持仓，每个数字都引用到具体文件和页码，且文档不会发送给聊天机器人。初创团队可询问“激活为什么停滞”，agent 在本地分析漏斗导出数据，找出新注册用户在安装到首次完成任务之间的流失点，并把关键洞察直接发布到团队 Slack 频道。这些例子显示，Portable Computer 面向隐私敏感、跨文件、多步骤和重复性知识工作。

此外，NVIDIA 还汇总了本地 AI 生态的最新更新：Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 Flash 以低成本提供出色性能和视觉智能，针对 DGX Station 和双 DGX Spark 系统优化；DeepSeek-v4.1 Flash 显著降低复杂 AI agent 工作负载的键值缓存内存需求和运营成本，提升“每美元智能”；Qwen 发布开放权重多模态混合专家模型 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，以及 Qwen4 早期预览，后者可在单台 DGX Spark 上通过 NVFP4 本地运行，表现超出其体量；GLM 5.3 是 Z.ai 的 7440 亿参数旗舰模型，面向在 DGX Station 和四台 DGX Spark 集群上运行数小时的 agent 会话。整体来看，Perplexity Portable Computer 的发布是 NVIDIA 本地 AI 战略的一部分：把 agentic AI 从云端延伸到 Windows RTX PC、工作站和 DGX 系统，在隐私、成本和云端高级推理之间提供可编排的平衡。

history.title: Proven 8-pin PCIe plugs aren't immune to melting — Thermal Grizzly WireView adapter burns out on Radeon RX 7900 XTX
history.description: Three 8-pin connectors on a Thermal Grizzly WireView reportedly suffered burning and melting while connected to a Radeon RX 7900 XTX, with the company now investigating what caused the failure.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 16 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you believe that the 8-pin PCIe power connector is entirely immune to the problems that have plagued the newer 16-pin connector, think again. A recent incident suggests that even the humble 8-pin is not entirely immune to failure. According to a Radeon RX 7900 XTX owner on Reddit, the 8-pin connectors on a Thermal Grizzly WireView monitoring device suffered overheating damage while connected to the graphics card.The user said that they experienced frequent freezes and black screens before discovering the damage. The affected connectors were the 8-pin connectors on the GPU side of the monitoring device, with visible signs of burning and melted plastic. The user also confirmed that the connectors were fully inserted, although the exact cause of the failure is still unknown.WireView is essentially an adapter that sits between a graphics card and the power cables, allowing users to monitor various values like power consumption, voltages, current in amperes, minimum and maximum power consumption, and more. Rather than connecting the PSU cables directly to the GPU, the power passes through the monitoring device, thus adding another set of connectors and electrical contacts to the power delivery path. A poor electrical connection, increased contact resistance, a damaged connector, or an issue with the adapter itself could have caused the overheating damage.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Thermal Grizzly previously pointed to improper seating, backplate interference, or incorrectly aligned or soldered contacts as possible causes of connector damage, although the company is yet to identify the cause of this particular incident. The company has reportedly contacted the affected user and asked them to get in touch with its support team so the company can investigate the damaged WireView adapter. The investigation could potentially help determine whether the failure originated from the adapter, the connectors, the GPU, or a combination of factors.While we are on the subject of 8-pin power connectors, just days ago we saw a heavily modified RTX 5090 successfully running on traditional 8-pin connectors. The modders replaced the card's original 16-pin connectors with three 8-pin connectors soldered directly to the PCB, using heavy-gauge cables and modified sense pins. The card reportedly pulled as much as 900W and reached 3,400 MHz, demonstrating how capable 8-pin connectors can be when properly implemented. However, this was an extreme hardware modification, not a stock configuration. history.titleZh: Proven 8-pin PCIe plugs aren't immune to melting — Thermal Grizzly WireView adapter burns out on Radeon RX 7900 XTX
history.descriptionZh:
近日，Tom's Hardware报道了一起与8-pin PCIe供电接口有关的过热损坏事件，打破了“传统8-pin接口完全不受16-pin熔化问题影响”的常见印象。一位Reddit上的Radeon RX 7900 XTX用户在显卡与Thermal Grizzly WireView功耗监控适配器之间使用8-pin连接，随后频繁遇到死机、黑屏，检查后发现WireView朝向GPU一侧的8-pin接口出现烧灼和塑料熔化。用户确认接口已完全插紧，但具体故障原因仍未确定。

背景方面，新一代16-pin显卡供电接口曾因熔化、烧毁问题引发广泛关注，许多玩家因此认为成熟、久经考验的8-pin接口更安全。此次事件表明，8-pin也并非绝对免疫，尤其是在供电路径中加入了转接、延长或监控设备之后。问题未必来自8-pin标准本身，而可能来自额外增加的连接环节。

WireView本质上是一个串联在显卡和电源线之间的监测适配器。电源不是直接接入显卡，而是先经过WireView，再进入GPU。它可以监测功耗、电压、电流安培数、最小和最大功耗等数据。由于供电链路中多了一组连接器和电气接触点，也就多了一个潜在故障点。若出现电气接触不良、接触电阻升高、连接器损坏或适配器本身异常，在大电流下就可能产生局部高温，最终导致过热损坏。Thermal Grizzly此前曾将不当插入、背板干涉、接触件未对准或焊接不良列为连接器损坏的可能原因，但本次事件的直接原因仍待调查。公司已联系受影响用户，并要求其联系支持团队，以便对损坏的WireView适配器进行检测，从而判断故障源头是适配器、连接器、GPU，还是多种因素共同作用。

作为对比，就在数天前，有改装者成功让一块重度改装的RTX 5090使用传统8-pin接口运行。他们将显卡原装的16-pin接口替换为三个直接焊接在PCB上的8-pin接口，并使用粗线规电缆和修改过的sense pins。该卡据称功耗高达900W，频率达到3400 MHz，说明8-pin接口在正确实施的情况下仍具备很强的供电能力。不过，这属于极端硬件改装，并非原厂配置，普通用户不能将其等同于常规使用环境。

这一事件的技术影响在于，它提醒高端显卡用户和厂商：随着显卡功耗不断攀升，供电接口、转接线、监控适配器都可能成为系统薄弱点。WireView等监控工具虽然方便玩家掌握功耗、电压和电流状况，适合超频和功耗分析场景，但也会增加供电路径的复杂度和接触电阻风险。对于普通用户，应确保接口完全插入，避免背板干涉，使用质量可靠的线材和适配器，并留意异常发热、死机或黑屏等征兆。对于厂商，则需要进一步调查故障机制，并改进连接器和适配器设计。相关报道还包括改装RTX 5090放弃16-pin改用三8-pin、改装者将电源线直接焊到RTX 5090 PCB以消除熔化隐患，以及有爱好者称DLSS 5使RTX 5090功耗超过600W并熔化16-pin连接器等，均反映出当前高端显卡供电接口仍是需要重点关注的风险环节。

history.title: Maryland data center developers offer residents biggest-ever US community benefits package as big tech seeks to quell fears — $110 million deal includes $30 million elementary school, water reclamation system, and more
history.description: A new report claims AI data center builders are getting more savvy about offering communities tangible benefits to get their projects approved.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Residents of Frederick County, Maryland, could be the beneficiaries of what is purported to be the biggest residential benefits package yet to be offered by data center developers, in a move a new report claims is a sign of a growing trend that Big Tech is trying to get ahead of fears and community pushback surrounding AI infrastructure. The $110 million deal includes new schools, water reclamation, and more, The Information reports. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleAccording to the report, the Frederick Digital Campus offering could be a sign that data center developers like Amazon, Microsoft, and Oracle are wising up to growing residential pushback and concerns around the building of large AI data centers in their communities, with developers "sweetening financial offers to municipalities and regulators to gain approval for new facilities" while "getting smarter" about ensuring they shoulder the cost of utilities like electricity. The report says AI builders are turning towards tangible benefits, rather than rhetoric, to get their projects approved.The Maryland site, if approved, would see residents of Frederick County benefit from a $110 million investment in total, including a $30 million elementary school, $40 million of recreational facilities, a $14.5 million workforce training center, and a further $10.5 million for "agricultural preservation." That comes on top of a purported $215 million in annual property taxes the campus would pay upon completion, a 40% uptick in tax revenue.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: It appears the developers have also offered concessions regarding construction, reducing the square footage by almost 20%, and reducing potable water (water safe for human consumption and use) usage by 80%, with up to $100 million also proposed for a water reclamation system.The proposal is yet to be approved, but if passed, the campus would boast Amazon and Aligned Data centers amongst its tenants. The report reiterates the deal "reflects a rapidly emerging consensus by both tech companies and host governments to eliminate giveaways to developers and to accelerate benefits to towns in the vicinity of the facilities." history.titleZh: Maryland data center developers offer residents biggest-ever US community benefits package as big tech seeks to quell fears — $110 million deal includes $30 million elementary school, water reclamation system, and more
history.descriptionZh:
据 The Information 报道，美国马里兰州弗雷德里克县居民可能将获得迄今为止数据中心开发商提供的最大规模居民利益方案。这份总额约 1.1 亿美元的协议包括新建学校、水回收系统等，被视为大型科技公司为应对 AI 基础设施引发的社区担忧和抵制而采取的新策略。随着 AI 数据中心对电力、水资源和土地的需求激增，居民越来越担心电价上涨、供水紧张、噪音污染以及地方税收和公用事业成本被转嫁，数据中心开发商正试图通过更直接、可量化的社区投资来换取项目审批。

拟议中的“弗雷德里克数字园区”若获批，将为弗雷德里克县带来 1.1 亿美元总投资，其中包括 3000 万美元的小学、4000 万美元的娱乐设施、1450 万美元的劳动力培训中心，以及 1050 万美元的农业保护资金。此外，园区建成后预计每年缴纳 2.15 亿美元财产税，使当地税收增加约 40%。开发商还提出建设方面的让步：建筑面积减少近 20%，饮用水用量减少 80%，并计划投入最高 1 亿美元建设水回收系统。该园区租户预计包括亚马逊和 Aligned Data Centers，但目前提案尚未获批。

这一案例反映出一种正在形成的共识：科技公司和地方政府都希望不再向数据中心开发商提供过多无偿优惠，而是加快让周边社区获得实际利益。报道认为，亚马逊、微软、甲骨文等公司正在“学聪明”，不仅向市政和监管机构提供更优厚的财务方案，还更重视承担电力等公用事业成本。换句话说，AI 基础设施开发商正从过去的公关话术，转向学校、培训、娱乐、农业保护和水资源回收等看得见的投入，以争取“社会许可”。

类似趋势还出现在其他地区。据报道，AWS 在宾夕法尼亚州 Homer City 规划了一个 4.5GW、36 栋建筑的数据中心园区，并宣布不寻求任何经济激励来减轻税收负担。微软则被指在威斯康星州挑战 American Transmission Co. 和 We Energies 的提案，认为该方案不足以保护零售客户，若数据中心需求低于预期，普通用户可能被迫承担费用。谷歌和亚马逊也在弗吉尼亚州游说监管机构，要求由自己资助其基础设施所需的输电升级，而不是让能源公司通过提高客户账单来覆盖成本。

从技术影响和应用场景看，AI 数据中心需要大规模、稳定的电力和冷却用水，因此其选址和扩建越来越受地方监管、能源价格和水资源约束。当前美国已有约 500 个数据中心因各类禁令、暂停令和法律程序被搁置，AI 数据中心禁令在全国范围内超过 500 起。大型科技公司已在 AI 基础设施上投入超过 1 万亿美元，因此即便数亿美元的本地投资对它们而言也只是“九牛一毛”。但这类投资可能成为未来数据中心项目审批的模板：通过承担公用事业升级成本、减少环境足迹、直接回馈社区，来降低地方反对风险。若该模式推广，数据中心开发商的项目成本可能上升，但审批确定性和社区关系有望改善；若无法平息居民担忧，地方禁令和暂停政策仍可能继续增加。

history.descriptionZh:
Reddit 用户 Tsuto 在 r/homelab 版块分享称，自己从附近县垃圾填埋场的电子废弃物回收区淘零件，组装出一台足以用于家庭实验室的 Proxmox 服务器。他如今每周都会去该填埋场专门存放电子产品的区域“寻宝”。在 2026 年 PC 组件短缺、内存价格高企的背景下，这一做法尤其引人关注：文章指出，即使是 RTX 3060、AM4 主板/CPU、DDR4 内存等上一代产品，零售市场仍有人在抢购，说明组件供应紧张已让废弃硬件重新具备可观价值。Tsuto 的收获包括 SSD、HDD、GPU、内存、完整笔记本等，他感叹“现在人们扔的东西太疯狂了”。

具体来看，Tsuto 找到的一台 Asus ROG 游戏笔记本只需从亚马逊花 25 美元买一块电池就能使用。该笔记本配置为 Intel Core i7-4710HQ（4 核 8 线程）、16GB 内存和 GeForce GTX 860M 2GB 显卡，性能虽老，但足以让他儿子玩《Stumble Guys》这类要求不高的休闲游戏。另一项核心成果是用垃圾场零件搭建的 Proxmox 服务器：两个 256GB SSD 以镜像方式安装操作系统，一个额外 1TB SSD 用作快速存储，三个 2TB HDD 以 RAID1/镜像方式组成 ZFS 存储池。尽管大量零件来自填埋场，他仍从亚马逊购买了关键部件——Core i7-7700 和 64GB 内存，以最终完成系统。文章还调侃称，希望这 64GB 内存不是最近几个月买的，因为当前内存价格很高。

从技术原理看，Proxmox VE 是基于 Debian 的开源虚拟化平台，集成 KVM 虚拟机与 LXC 容器，适合家庭实验室、自托管和开发测试。ZFS 则是集文件系统与卷管理于一体的存储方案，支持写时复制、快照、校验、压缩和镜像/RAID 等能力；RAID1 通过多盘镜像提供冗余，但会牺牲容量利用率。三块 2TB HDD 做镜像可理解为三路镜像，可用容量约等于单块 2TB，却能容忍多盘故障。两个 256GB SSD 镜像保证系统盘可靠性，1TB SSD 提升虚拟机或热数据性能，HDD 则承担大容量 ZFS 存储，形成典型的分层存储。Core i7-7700 为 4 核 8 线程，搭配 64GB 内存，虽在单核性能、能效和 PCIe 通道上落后现代平台，但对运行多台虚拟机、容器和 NAS/媒体服务已足够；ZFS 还可能利用空闲内存作 ARC 缓存，因此大内存对存储性能也有帮助。

这一案例的技术影响不在发明新架构，而在于把企业级虚拟化与存储栈——Proxmox、ZFS、RAID1、SSD/HDD 分层——与废弃消费硬件结合，形成低成本、可持续的家庭云方案。其应用场景包括家庭实验室、虚拟化测试、自托管服务、NAS、媒体服务器、轻量游戏和儿童娱乐等。文章还列出类似案例：有人在车库发现价值 12,000 美元的 RAM，有人在 30 美元扩展卡中发现价值 1,500 美元的三星 SSD，还有人回收到 12 块矿潮时期的 RTX 3070。这些例子都说明电子废弃物中可能潜藏高价值硬件。不过，文章也提醒，并非所有地方都能随意从回收中心取走电子产品，一些回收站配有安保和摄像头，想“淘垃圾”仍需遵守当地法规与回收站规定。总体而言，在硬件短缺和涨价周期中，旧硬件的二次利用既具经济价值，也有减少电子垃圾的环保意义。
